$\frac{\partial f}{\partial x}=y^2+2xz，\quad \frac{\partial^2f}{\partial x^2}=2z，\quad \frac{\partial^2f}{\partial x\partial z}=2x，\quad \frac{\partial f}{\partial y}=2xy+z^2，\quad \frac{\partial^2f}{\partial y\partial z}=2z，\quad \frac{\partial f}{\partial z}=2yz+x^2，\quad \frac{\partial^2f}{\partial z^2}=2y，$
